steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Order. Each hour's output is placed against the target for its line.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 hour is below target with no downtime

findings.title: Hour more than 10 percent below target with no downtime
findings.fix: Find out what stopped output in that hour

findings.title: Hour with no output record
findings.fix: Record the output for the hour

findings.title: Quality of the output not recorded

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] line-a-h09.csv:12  Hour more than 10 percent below target with no downtime.
       Fix: Find out what stopped output in that hour.
[medium] line-b-h09.csv:19  Hour with no output record.
       Fix: Record the output for the hour.
[low] line-b-h10.csv:26  Quality of the output not recorded.
       Fix: Record a quality check.
Not checked: Quality of the output.
pros: Checks an hour more than 10 percent below target with no downtime recorded, and an hour with no output record.
cons: Not checked: Quality of the output.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-mfg-shift-output-log skill on the records for this review.
